note: The little white schoolhouse seen from its yard: the same building as on the village square (giant open book for a roof with blank pages, blank plaque, double green door, stone steps, potted bay tree). Ground floor: entrance alphabet classroom, second alphabet room (zoom: chalkboard), counting room (zoom: desk), articles room (zoom: teacher's desk), questions room (zoom: pupil's desk), first pronouns hall; first floor (stairs up from the pronouns hall): higher numbers (zoom: table), pronouns (2), prepositions (1), prepositions (2), conjunctions (zoom: desk); attic (stairs up from the conjunctions room): pronouns (3) and prepositions (3). Inside walk: R_alphabet_01 -> R_numbers1 -> R_articles -> R_questions -> R_pronouns_01 -> (stairs up) R_numbers2 -> R_pronouns_02 -> R_prepositions_01 -> R_prepositions_02 -> R_conjunctions -> (stairs up) R_pronouns_03 -> R_prepositions_03; R_alphabet_02 opens off the entrance classroom.
